description: Install an extension for the whole company. Takes the `extensionId` from get_extension_catalog, never a name. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the extension: this is not a personal setting — it changes the cabinet for EVERY user of the company, and several extensions do real work on install (WooCommerce connects the store and starts syncing, TIMEmSYSTEM writes default settings, Custom Payment schedules Stripe billing). MONEY: an extension with a non-zero `price` starts costing the merchant from the moment it is installed — quote the stored price string and let them decide. Installing is not enough to finish a setup: most extensions then need their own settings page in the cabinet (a WooCommerce store URL, a payment gateway key), which this agent cannot fill in — say that plainly after installing. Refused when the plan excludes the extension, when the caller lacks the Extensions permission, or when it is already installed (installing twice is not a no-op — it would run the side effects again).

extensionId.description: extensionId from get_extension_catalog — not a name, not a guid
